text:
Priya (growth): quick pulse — i noticed a weird spike in launch-posts impressions yesterday, can anyone pull the dashboard?
Sam Nguyen: looking now. which dashboard + timeframe?
Priya (growth): Launch > Social posts > last 48h. dashboard link: https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/launch-performance?range=48h
Maya R.: I see it, impressions up ~2.4x at 03:00-06:00 UTC, but CTR down. wonder if paid push went live?
Jordan L.: Ads team did a small promo at 02:45 UTC in APAC — should be tagged as paid. but inbound leads from that window are marked organic in our CRM.
Sam Nguyen: ah that's the routing bug we fixed last month? maybe backfilled rows not applied. pinging OpsBot to check ETL logs.
OpsBot: ingest-pipeline job completed at 03:15 UTC with 0 errors. mapping.rules.v2 applied.
Priya (growth): ok so impressions likely paid but attribution tag not preserved to leads. that explains lower CVR. can we confirm at the click-level?
Maya R.: pulled click-export: 1,240 clicks during spike. utm_source mostly present, but utm_medium missing on ~280 clicks. looks like our share-link generator dropped medium param for certain mobile clients.
Jordan L.: filing a short task for dev to patch generator. assigning Sam to confirm roll-forward fix and reprocess leads. Sam?
Sam Nguyen: on it — will coordinate with eng, re-run mapping for the affected window, and post a reprocessed lead sample here. ETA 4 hours.
Priya (growth): thanks. also can we add a dashboard annotation for the spike & reprocessed status so weekly report notes don't freak out stakeholders?
Maya R.: will add annotation + a small note in the weekly metrics doc. sample note: "03:00 UTC spike driven by paid APAC promo; initial medium missing on some mobile clicks; leads reprocessed 4h after detection."
Jordan L.: quick messaging note — do we need to pause any follow-ups from organic nurture? might duplicate outreach if we reclassify to paid.
Priya (growth): good catch. please hold automated nurture for the reprocessed lead IDs until we confirm new tags.
Sam Nguyen: acknowledged. will add a hold flag in the CRM for 280 lead IDs and share list when done.
Maya R.: also running a short A/B on the launch-post copy next week — will share hypothesis in #marketing later.
Priya (growth): perfect. final ask: include the reprocessed numbers in Friday KPI review so we can show adjusted conversion and CAC.
Jordan L.: noted. I’ll update the KPI slide with pre/post numbers once Sam posts the reprocessed sample.
Sam Nguyen: sample posted: https://s3.redwood.com/exports/launch-spike-sample.csv (contains 50 reclassified leads). reprocess job id: reproc-2026-03-23-01.
Priya (growth): thanks team. follow-ups: Sam — reprocess and hold unconverted leads; Maya — annotate & add note to weekly metrics; Jordan — pause nurture; I’ll brief stakeholders in Friday sync. :thumbsup:
